data.name: SKY LEGENDS - An Aeropostal Epic
data.detailed_description:
SKY LEGENDS – An Aeropostal Epic

Dive into the legendary adventures of the pioneers of civil aviation in the 1920s. In virtual reality, step into the shoes of the pilots and key figures of this era to take on the challenges of the first commercial air crossings.

Take the controls of the most iconic aircraft of their time and relive historic moments in carefully crafted, immersive atmospheres, in an experience worthy of a great adventure film.

Whether you’re passionate about aviation or history, or simply seeking an immersive narrative experience, Sky Legends offers varied gameplay experiences, accessible to both newcomers and seasoned players, for a unique journey through time.

Varied Piloting Experiences:

Discover multiple types of immersive flights that will transport you to the heart of history:

◆ Reconnaissance Flights – Explore new territories and diverse landscapes to establish new airfields.
◆ Formation Flights – Fly alongside other aircraft in precision piloting challenges.
◆ Historic Moments – Relive significant events such as Jean Mermoz’s crossing of the Atlantic Ocean or the crash of Henri Guillaumet, known as “the survivor,” in the Andes mountains.

Take Control of Multiple Characters:

In Sky Legends, embody several iconic figures of French airmail history, across different eras and locations:

◆ Pilots – Experience the incredible adventures of pioneering aviators like Antoine de Saint-Exupéry.
◆ Mechanics and Engineers – Contribute to the design, maintenance, and repair of new aircraft.
◆ Managers and Investors – Each character immerses you in their world and responsibilities, from company executives to operations directors.

Relive a Thrilling, Ultra-Immersive Story Through Virtual Reality:

Experience firsthand the preparations for flights, technical challenges, and the pivotal moments that forged these great aerial adventures.

Thanks to the unparalleled immersion offered by virtual reality, feel the intensity of each scene as if you were truly there, and become an active participant in this remarkable chapter of history.

data.short_description: Play as the iconic pioneers of aviation and fly their legendary aircraft. Between human challenges and technical feats, cross the extreme landscapes of the Sahara, the Andes, or the Atlantic in an immersive, narrative, and historical virtual reality adventure.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bits
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA 3060 RTX / AMD RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • VR Support: Oculus OPEN XR
  • Additional Notes: Officially tested on Meta Quest 2 and Meta Quest 3 headsets via SteamLink and SteamVR. Compatible, but not officially tested on Oculus Rift CV1/S, Meta Quest Pro/3S. Other SteamVR headsets are not officially supported.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64bits
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-13600K / AMD Ryzen 5 7600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA 4070 RTX / AMD RX 7800 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • VR Support: Oculus OPEN XR
  • Additional Notes: Officially tested on Meta Quest 2 and Meta Quest 3 headsets via SteamLink and SteamVR. Compatible, but not officially tested on Oculus Rift CV1/S, Meta Quest Pro/3S. Other SteamVR headsets are not officially supported.
